message.worldeater.singularity_limit: Active black hole limit reached. An operator can remove them with /worldeater stop.
message.worldeater.block_destruction_dis: Block consumption is disabled for you here. Entity pull and damage remain active.
message.worldeater.stopped: Stopped %s black holes and released their chunk tickets.
message.worldeater.orbit_missing: Orbit dimension is unavailable. Restart the world after installing the mod; check that its dimension datapack is enabled.
message.worldeater.orbit_op_only: Death Star access requires an operator on this server.
config.worldeater.orbit_operator_only: Death Star: operators only on servers
message.worldeater.orbit_unavailable: Stand up, dismount, and leave spectator mode before entering orbit.
message.worldeater.orbit_cannon_disabled: Singularity Cannon is disabled inside the orbit dimension.
message.worldeater.orbit_no_session: You have no active orbit visit to return from.
message.worldeater.orbit_transfer_blocke: The return teleport was blocked. Your saved state is still available. Try /worldeater return again.
message.worldeater.orbit_returned: Returned from orbit. Your saved player state has been restored.
message.worldeater.planet_failed: Planet preparation stopped because a chunk could not be processed. You can still return safely; leave orbit and re-enter to retry.
message.worldeater.planet_clear: Preparing the orbital display - right-click to return
message.worldeater.planet_ready: Planet ready: %s-block radius, scan half-width %s blocks. Look down through the glass deck; 16-chunk view distance is recommended. Select Superlaser Trigger in slot 2, aim at the green marker, and hold right-click to charge. Slot 1 returns home.
message.worldeater.laser_target: Target X %s, Z %s | destruction radius %s | hold right-click to charge
message.worldeater.orbit_confirm: DEATH STAR: BACK UP YOUR WORLD FIRST! The superlaser permanently destroys a large area, up to %s blocks from its target. Right-click again within 10 seconds to enter orbit. Firing requires holding the separate Superlaser Trigger.
message.worldeater.laser_paused: Superlaser paused after a processing error. Tickets were released. An operator can use /worldeater resumelaser to retry or /worldeater stoplaser to cancel.
message.worldeater.laser_stopped: Stopped %s superlaser job(s). Already destroyed terrain is not restored.
message.worldeater.laser_not_ready: Superlaser unavailable: wait for a fresh planet, aim at its surface, and ensure you have destruction permission. Each visit can fire once.
message.worldeater.orbit_entered: Death Star - Orbital Command. Look down through the glass deck to the planet. Slot 1: Death Star returns home. Slot 2: Superlaser Trigger aims and charges after the planet is ready. Terrain scanning/building is starting.
message.worldeater.planet_complete: Planet ready - select Superlaser Trigger to aim
message.worldeater.laser_fired: Superlaser fired at X %s, Z %s. Destruction radius: %s blocks. The wave continues if you leave orbit; large blasts can take a long time.
message.worldeater.laser_invalid_target: That target is unavailable or outside the source world border.
message.worldeater.laser_still_running: Your previous superlaser wave is still active. Wait for completion; an operator can use /worldeater stoplaser to stop it.
message.worldeater.laser_complete: Superlaser sequence complete. Returning any active orbit visit home.
